Corollary
[O'Neill nonimmersion corollary] 1. ch10:3.5If $\overline M$ is complete simply connected with $K_{\overline M}\leq 0$, $M$ is compact with $\dim \overline M<2\dim M$, and $K_M\leq K_{\overline M}$, then no isometric immersion $M\to \overline M$ exists.
